sourceContract.uiAction: Show exact staged members/bytes and obtain this separate warning acknowledgement; never imply that partial data can be retried as a verified export. Active writer/chooser references remain hard blockers.
sourceContract.scope: Private-copy confirmable warning, not a new CSV ImportIssue

entries.translationNotes: The consequence is conditional/future tense; the copy does not say deletion has already happened. It states only that completeness has not been verified and makes no promise of a complete-copy retry.

implementationBoundary.resourceKeyLookup: Use each exact resourceKey/reason/code. Do not use diagnostic substring dispatch.
implementationBoundary.typedArguments: Retain exact source argument names, types, and machine field paths. Pass user values, identifiers, en-US, and stable rule tokens through unchanged; do not translate or normalize them.
implementationBoundary.runtimeStatus: Editorial handoff only. No app resources, UI, runtime locale support, or native-speaker acceptance is claimed.

editorialRevisions.review: Coordinator meaning/wording review; not native-speaker or runtime QA.
editorialRevisions.reason: Use day-start wording, avoid Chinese international-date-line ambiguity; use retained data rather than literal bytes. Exact sourceContract unchanged.
